open_issues: rpg/systems/PROGRESSION_ECONOMY.md §1 models the twenty-hour trace at 4,370 experience (3,240 + 530 + 460 + 140) and states 'level 8 with thirty to spare'; rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §7 totals the same trace at 4,343, which is level 8 with five to spare. Not a design smell; one of the two arithmetics needs re-running.

Distances disagree: rpg/world/WORLD.md §2.8 and rpg/systems/LIVING_WORLD.md §1 put Sallowford eight miles and three hours from Wickery, while rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §1 gives segments (four miles to Hobb's Cross, four to the Rudd Bridge, one hour on to Wickery) summing to about eleven miles and three hours forty.

rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §7, hour 3:00 reads renown 27 as 'still Villager' although rpg/systems/CLASSES_AND_STANDING.md §5 sets the Hand floor at 20; the parenthetical implies the dawn recompute has not run, but the standing file does not state that the tier is only recomputed at dawn for display.

rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §4 is headed 'Three powers present' while its body correctly says five powers act on the valley and three have a face and a seat in it; the heading matches the brief's wording but reads as a contradiction on its own.

Design-smell audit found no hits: no unnamed or unfinished-marker names anywhere in the bible; no name, place, god, race or artefact traceable to any other IP; four peoples, five powers, three ages exactly; no prophecy or chosen-one framing (the one page says 'a trade and no destiny'); every sample quest names people and sits on a mapped site whose state caused it; no gacha, energy, stamina gate, timer, pity or pull under any name (the Fighter's and Rogue's 'stamina' is a per-fight combat resource, not a session gate); nothing sold buys power or skips the world.
